summary: PVH Corp. filed an 8-K solely to disclose the appointment of Alexis Rollier as Chief Financial Officer, replacing interim CFO Melissa Stone who moves to a different role. This is an ordinary executive succession, not a forced or abrupt departure triggered by an activist or scandal. The filing contains no M&A, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, delisting, or any special-situation transaction. No deal terms, premiums, or financial mechanics are stated. The event is a routine senior hire governed by a standard employment agreement with a base salary of $850,000.
